## DeskHelper Pro 1.1.0
**New** - **Display Resolution** — a menu-bar tool to switch your display's resolution instantly, and to create and install custom HiDPI ("Retina-style") resolutions. Each preset shows a clear status: available, installable, available after reboot, or rejected by macOS. - **7z & ZIP in Secure Archive** — create and extract password-protected 7z and ZIP archives from Finder. The engine is bundled, so there is nothing extra to install.
**Improvements** - Applied resolutions persist after you quit the app, with a 15-second confirm-or-revert safety in case a mode is not usable. - The Resolution window floats above other windows, follows you across Spaces, and closes with Esc. - Broader localization across all supported languages.
**Fixes** - More reliable menu-bar icon and background helper registration.
